name: Bursar Odele
title: Bursar of the Bank of Silverfall
examine: Dry as slate and twice as durable. Her signature underwrites every honest vault on two roads.
lines: State your business in figures where possible.
Four vaults, one ledger, zero exceptions. The poetry of banking is that there isn't any.
Young Cormund at the ford writes me twelve pages a season. I reply in one. He keeps them. I know, because he told me — in writing.
